articles.title: ChatGPT可虚拟试穿衣服了
articles.summary: OpenAI为ChatGPT增加购物功能，用户上传自己的照片就能虚拟试穿衣服和配饰，还能把喜欢的商品存进收藏库。
articles.why: 这是AI从聊天工具变成日常消费助手的一步，普通人用AI处理生活琐事又多了一个场景。
articles.beginner_takeaway: 可以想：AI帮你挑衣服、试效果，会改变你的购物习惯吗？
articles.source_title: ChatGPT can now virtually try on clothes for you

articles.title: 谷歌Gemini Live能实时读小字
articles.summary: 谷歌在Gemini Live中推出Guided Vision功能，用手机摄像头对准物体，AI就能实时语音描述看到的内容，比如读小字、认东西。
articles.why: 把摄像头变成AI的眼睛，对看不清小字、需要环境描述的人来说是很实际的功能。
articles.beginner_takeaway: 关注：AI正在从打字聊天走向用摄像头看世界。
articles.source_title: Google’s new Guided Vision feature can help you read the fine print

articles.title: AI能根据脑扫描还原你看到的画面
articles.summary: MIT科技评论报道，一款新AI工具通过分析脑部扫描，能相当精确地重建一个人正在看的图像，反过来也能根据图像预测脑活动。
articles.why: 这是脑机接口方向的新进展，虽然离日常使用很远，但说明AI读脑信号的能力在提升。
articles.beginner_takeaway: 了解：AI和大脑信号结合是长期研究方向，目前仍在实验阶段。
articles.source_title: An AI “mind-reading” tool can reconstruct what you’re looking at from a brain scan

articles.title: OpenAI与三名安全研究员分道扬镳
articles.summary: 据华尔街日报报道，OpenAI内部调查发现三名安全研究员不当处理公司敏感信息，随后与三人解除关系。
articles.why: 安全团队的人事变动可能影响AI安全研究的节奏，值得关注大公司在安全和商业之间的取舍。
articles.beginner_takeaway: 留意：AI安全不只是技术问题，也涉及公司内部管理。
articles.source_title: OpenAI cuts ties with 3 safety researchers, WSJ reports

articles.title: Grok被曝曾建议特朗普抓捕委总统
articles.summary: TechCrunch报道，特朗普在入侵委内瑞拉并抓捕马杜罗前，曾询问马斯克旗下AI聊天机器人Grok的意见，Grok给出了鼓励性建议。
articles.why: AI聊天机器人的输出可能影响真实政治决策，这提醒我们AI建议的边界和责任问题。
articles.beginner_takeaway: 思考：当AI给出建议时，谁该为后果负责？
articles.source_title: Musk’s AI chatbot Grok reportedly encouraged Trump to capture  Venezuela’s president

articles.title: 谷歌发射首颗TPU算力卫星
articles.summary: 谷歌将首颗搭载TPU芯片的算力卫星送入轨道，为未来在太空建设数据中心探路，但谷歌自己估算Starship需发射约1800次才能支撑。
articles.why: 把数据中心搬到太空是算力基础设施的新思路，虽然离落地很远，但代表大公司在算力上的长期布局。
articles.beginner_takeaway: 了解：AI算力需求正在推动各种大胆的基础设施尝试。
articles.source_title: Google thinks SpaceX’s Starship has to launch 1,800 times before space data centers get off the ground

articles.title: 亚马逊发布自己的决策模型
articles.summary: 亚马逊云科技旗下Strand Labs发布Strands Decider 2B，是一款类似Jev的轻量决策模型，用于辅助AI代理做判断。
articles.why: 决策模型是让AI代理不乱来的关键零件，大厂纷纷入局说明这个方向正在标准化。
articles.beginner_takeaway: 关注：AI代理背后需要专门的「决策小模型」来管住它们。
articles.source_title: Amazon releases its own Jev clone as decision models flood the web

articles.title: 法官驳回谷歌AI搜索反垄断诉讼
articles.summary: 美国联邦法官驳回Chegg和Penske Media对谷歌AI Overviews的反垄断诉讼，认为谷歌的AI搜索功能没有违法。
articles.why: 这关系到AI搜索是否会影响网站流量和内容生态，判决结果对依赖搜索流量的网站有参考意义。
articles.beginner_takeaway: 了解：AI搜索和传统网站之间的利益冲突正在进入法庭。
articles.source_title: Judge dismisses antitrust lawsuits over Google’s AI Overviews

articles.title: AI写作有「口头禅」，Opus 5.5爱说dependable
articles.summary: TechCrunch分析发现，Opus 5.5模型有个明显写作习惯：爱用「dependable」这个词，出现频率是人类的23倍，还爱说「this matters」。
articles.why: 了解AI写作的固定套路，能帮你分辨一篇文章是人写的还是AI写的，也能让自己用AI写作时更有意识。
articles.beginner_takeaway: 试试：读英文时留意哪些词是AI爱用的，慢慢就能认出AI文风。
articles.for_me: 读英文文章时留意dependable、this matters等词，能帮你判断文本是否AI生成，对英语阅读和写作都有参考。
articles.source_title: Opus 5.5 loves to tell you ‘this matters’ (and other AI writing tells)

items.summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) trains a student to match the teacher's next-token distributions on the student's own trajectories and has yielded substantial empirical gains. Generalized variants allow the student to surpass the teacher by extrapolating an implicit reward in output space. items.title_cn: 老师是方向而非终点：在在线蒸馏中外推强化学习诱导的表征残差
items.note: 指出语言模型头会各向异性地削弱教师隐状态变化，提出外推表征残差让学生超越教师。

items.title_en: UniEvo-VL: An On-policy Self-Distillation Training Recipe for Multimodal Model Self-improvement
items.summary: Modern multimodal models bring generation and understanding into a single unified system, which enables them to provide and learn from their own feedback. Motivated by this unified capacity, we introduce UniEvo-VL, a self-evolving framework for multimodal models to learn from this constructive self-correction feedback during test-time compute. items.title_cn: UniEvo-VL：多模态模型自我提升的在线自蒸馏训练配方
items.note: 让统一多模态模型用自身批判作为特权信息，在测试时自我纠错进化，无需更大教师模型。

items.title_en: Rethinking Latent Visual Reasoning: Grounding Latent Reasoning in Visual Evidence
items.summary: Latent visual reasoning (LVR) enables multimodal large language models (MLLMs) to perform intermediate computation in continuous latent tokens rather than expressing every reasoning step in words. However, unlike textual CoT, latent reasoning is not directly observable, making it difficult to supervise what latent tokens learn. items.title_cn: 重思潜在视觉推理：将潜在推理锚定于视觉证据
items.note: 分析潜在token行为，发现其对图像扰动响应弱，提出把潜在推理扎根于视觉证据。

items.title_en: False Frontiers: Diagnosing and Mitigating Co-Cheating in Self-Evolving Search Agents
items.summary: Self-evolving search agents build their own training curricula by jointly optimizing a proposer that generates questions and a solver that answers them. This closed loop introduces a failure mode we call co-cheating: the proposer and solver increasingly agree on shared errors, so internal reward improves without a matching gain in external correctness. items.title_cn: 虚假前沿：诊断与缓解自进化搜索智能体中的共同作弊
items.note: 揭示出题者与解题者共享错误、内部奖励虚高的共同作弊现象，并给出缓解方法。

items.title_en: AREX-2: Advancing Self-Improving Agents through Long-Horizon Reflective Tasks
items.summary: We present AREX-2, an effort to advance the self-improving capability of LLM agents, which we define as the ability to iteratively refine a solution at test time. This ability rests on two complementary capabilities: reflection, which produces a solution better than the current one, and long-horizon execution, which keeps the iteration effective over many rounds. items.title_cn: AREX-2：通过长时程反思任务推进自我改进智能体
items.note: 提出用反思与长时程执行两类可迁移能力，在可监督场景中训练智能体测试时迭代改进。

items.title_en: Raven: The Harness of Harnesses for Composable Agentic Intelligence
items.summary: As large language models advance, AI agents are moving beyond isolated, domain-specific tasks toward long-horizon, cross-domain workflows. This transition exposes two challenges: increasing harness complexity makes manual design difficult to scale, while tighter coupling to specific domains limits the generality of a single harness. The central question thus shifts from how to engineer a stronger harness for one domain to how to autonomously construct specialized harnesses, improve them through
items.title_cn: Raven：面向可组合智能体智能的“框架之框架”
items.note: 提出自主构建并改进跨领域专用智能体框架，以应对框架复杂度和通用性挑战。

items.title_en: MaLiang-Harness: A Programmable Path to Image and Video Generation
items.summary: Executable programs offer explicit control over how images and videos are constructed, but generating runnable code is only the beginning of visual creation. A program can execute correctly while violating the requested composition, appearance, or motion. We define this discrepancy as the Program-to-Visual (P2V) gap and introduce MaLiang-Harness, a unified framework for organizing MLLM-driven visual generation into a persistent process of construction, inspection, and revision. Its central desig
items.title_cn: MaLiang-Harness：通向图像与视频生成的可编程路径
items.note: 定义程序到视觉的差距，用构建、检查、修订的持续流程组织多模态模型驱动的视觉生成。

items.title_en: In-Context Learning for Robots: Methods and Applications
items.summary: General-purpose robots must infer what a new task requires and translate that understanding into appropriate physical action. In-context learning (ICL) for robots supports this process by using demonstrations and interaction to direct existing competence with neural parameters held fixed during deployment. We organize this literature review around the interfaces connecting contextual evidence to execution, distinguishing four families: context-conditioned policies, geometric demonstration transf
items.title_cn: 机器人上下文学习：方法与应用
items.note: 综述机器人如何用示范和交互引导已有能力，按上下文到执行的接口分为四类方法。

items.title_en: Scaling Properties of Same-Family On-Policy Distillation
items.summary: *Reinforcement learning (RL)* can induce substantial reasoning capabilities in large language models (LLMs), but how much of this capability transfers across model scales, and how quickly, remains unclear. We study the scaling properties of *on-policy distillation (OPD)* across *weak-to-strong*, *same-base*, and *strong-to-weak* teacher--student setups. We find that early OPD training dynamics uniformly exhibit a regular *useful-transfer* regime, in which held-out accuracy (the *gold score*, G)
items.title_cn: 同族在线蒸馏的缩放性质
items.note: 研究弱到强、同基座、强到弱三种师生设置下在线蒸馏的缩放规律与迁移效率。

items.title_en: Omni-IO Skills: Harnessing Your Agent Omni-Native
items.summary: General-purpose agents can plan, reason, and act over long horizons, yet their production capabilities remain fragmented across text, images, audio, video, documents, 3D assets, and code. Extending a foundation model to additional modalities ties capability growth to costly model updates, while assembling specialist models and tools leaves unresolved how procedures, dependencies, intermediate assets, and cross-turn revisions should be coordinated. We present Omni-IO Skills, a plug-and-play Agent
items.title_cn: Omni-IO Skills：让智能体原生驾驭全模态
items.note: 提出即插即用技能框架，协调文本、图像、音视频、3D与代码等多模态生产流程。

items.title_en: Post-Training Leaves Behavioral Shadows on Unrelated Decisions
items.summary: We find that language models can transfer capabilities through task-unrelated text. Post-training typically improves language models using task-specific data. Prior work on subliminal learning shows that information about these updates can pass through unrelated generations, but has largely focused on traits or preferences using extensive teacher outputs. We introduce Active Taskless Distillation (ATD), which achieves capability transfer using only a single word from the teacher per prompt. ATD
items.title_cn: 后训练会在无关决策上留下行为影子
items.note: 提出主动无任务蒸馏，仅用教师每提示一个词即可实现跨任务的能力迁移。

items.title_en: YuE2: Unifying Symbolic and Audio Music Generation at Frontier Quality
items.summary: Symbolic models make melody, harmony, rhythm, and form explicit but typically stop before a finished recording; audio models produce complete songs while leaving composition implicit. We introduce YuE2, which unifies symbolic and audio music generation at frontier quality through symbolic planning. A single AR-NAR Mixture-of-Transformers (MoT) first writes a readable score specifying melody and harmony, expands it into semantic music tokens, and realizes it as full-song audio. In comparisons usi
items.title_cn: YuE2：以前沿质量统一符号与音频音乐生成
items.note: 用符号规划先写旋律和声乐谱，再扩展为语义token并生成完整歌曲音频。

items.title_en: VisionHOPE: Visual Backbones as Self-Modifying Learning Systems
items.summary: Visual backbones have evolved from Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) with local aggregation to Vision Transformers (ViTs) with global interactions, State-Space Models (SSMs) with input-dependent state transitions, and Test-Time Training (TTT) layers that adapt an inner learner while processing an image. Across this progression, visual computation has become increasingly adaptive to each input, yet the rules governing that adaptation remain largely prescribed by the trained backbone. We introd
items.title_cn: VisionHOPE：作为自修改学习系统的视觉骨干
items.note: 提出让视觉骨干的适应规则本身可被学习修改，而非由训练固定，以增强输入自适应性。

items.title_en: Beyond Teacher Assignment: Domain-Normalized Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation
items.summary: Reinforcement learning can turn one language model into several specialists, each excellent at a single skill such as mathematics, coding or following instructions, but users need one model with all of these skills. Multi-teacher on-policy distillation (MOPD) merges them by letting the specialists teach one student: the student answers each prompt, and the specialist for that prompt's domain gives feedback on every token. This routing decides which specialist teaches, but not how strongly its fe
items.title_cn: 超越教师分配：领域归一化多教师在线蒸馏
items.note: 指出多教师蒸馏中路由决定谁教但未决定教多强，提出按领域归一化教师影响强度。

items.title_en: Groupwise Agentic Grading and Advantage Redistribution for Code Agent RL
items.summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) for code agents often uses executable tests to provide binary rewards. With these rewards, Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) assigns identical advantages to test-passing trajectories within each rollout group, overlooking differences in implementation quality and adherence to task requirements. This leaves the policy without a learning signal that favors clean, targeted implementations over those containing unnecessary or out-of-scope changes. We introduce GAG
items.title_cn: 面向代码智能体强化学习的分组智能体评分与优势重分配
items.note: 针对GRPO对通过测试轨迹给相同优势的问题，提出按实现质量重分配优势的学习信号。

items.title_en: FuseReg: Regularizing Layer Fusion Mitigates the Reconstruction-Generation Gap in Representation Autoencoders
items.summary: Representation autoencoders (RAEs) reuse features from a pretrained visual encoder as reconstruction and diffusion latents, integrating strong visual representations into image generation. However, RAEs still need to decide which encoder layers form the shared latent space for the generator and pixel decoder. This choice involves a trade-off. Shallower layers tend to preserve fine pixel details better, while deeper layers tend to yield better generation metrics. A fixed heuristic layer fusion th
items.title_cn: FuseReg：正则化层融合缓解表征自编码器的重建-生成差距
items.note: 指出浅层利于重建、深层利于生成的权衡，用正则化层融合缓解该矛盾。

items.title_en: Disaggregated Quantization: Specializing LLM Prefill and Decode
items.summary: Prefill and decode reward different approaches to quantization: low-precision arithmetic accelerates prompt processing, while compact weights reduce memory traffic during generation. We propose "disaggregated quantization" (DQ), which specializes computation formats, weights and storage placement to both of these phases. On Qwen 3 and Gemma 3, removing activation quantization specifically on decode improves accuracy on decode-heavy tasks without increasing inference cost. Training separate compu
items.title_cn: 分离式量化：专门化大模型预填充与解码
items.note: 针对预填充与解码不同需求，分别专门化计算格式、权重与存储放置以兼顾速度与精度。

items.title_en: RayOrch: Programming and Executing Lineage-Controlled Multi-Grain Dataflows for Foundation-Model Data Preparation
items.summary: Preparing high quality training data for foundation models requires scalable pipelines that transform heterogeneous documents and videos into structured records. Such pipelines expand each parent item into an ordered and input dependent sequence of children, whose counts may be long tailed. GPUs should batch children across parents while preserving parent relationships, child order, completion status, and result routing. Existing systems either hide parallelism behind coarse grained jobs or expo
items.title_cn: RayOrch：面向基础模型数据准备的血缘可控多粒度数据流编程与执行
items.note: 提出支持父子关系、子序与结果路由的多粒度数据流系统，高效准备基础模型训练数据。

items.title_en: TimeEvo: Failure-Driven Self-Evolution of a Time Series Agent
items.summary: Time series agents answer analytical questions by calling external tools, and which tools they carry is decided by people before the agent runs. However, we identify two failures in this setup. Human-Agent Tool Misalignment: a library of 21 expert-curated tools helps on some tasks and hurts on others, dropping anomaly accuracy under every backbone we test. Silent Harm: one round of generic self-revision changes 147 answers and breaks 56 of them, while the final score moves by less than a point.
items.title_cn: TimeEvo：时间序列智能体的失败驱动自进化
items.note: 指出人工工具库与智能体不匹配及静默伤害两类失败，提出由失败驱动工具自进化。

items.title_en: Block Sparse Attention with Log-Linear Complexity
items.summary: Scaling language models to long contexts is limited by the quadratic cost of self-attention. Block sparse attention offers an efficient alternative, but selecting the retained blocks remains a bottleneck. Conventional block selection requires scoring all query-block pairs and therefore remains quadratic in sequence length. To address this issue, we propose PISA, a block-sparse attention mechanism that employs a pyramid Top-K selection strategy. The main idea is to gradually narrow down the candi
items.title_cn: 对数线性复杂度的块稀疏注意力
items.note: 提出金字塔Top-K选择的块稀疏注意力PISA，避免全查询-块打分，降低长上下文成本。

items.title_en: Training Object Permanence in World Models
items.summary: Object permanence and solidity are hallmarks of human cognitive priors. Recent studies show that video generation models, a paradigmatic class of current world models, have begun to show emerged reasoning abilities, making them ideal candidates for building human-like physical intelligence. Do video models have emerged object permanence in them? If not, could we train them with a core-cognition inspired dataset? We introduce WROP (World Reasoning with Object Permanence), a data infrastructure of
items.title_cn: 在世界模型中训练客体永久性
items.note: 构建WROP数据集，检验并训练视频世界模型获得客体永久性与固体性等认知先验。

items.title_en: Your Transformer Can Hold Two Thoughts at Once: Evidence of Linear Superposition in LLMs
items.summary: While Large Language Models (LLMs) rely on highly non-linear components, in this work we demonstrate that they exhibit fundamental linearity: when inputs from distinct text streams are linearly combined, the model outputs a superposition of the individual next-token distributions. We term this the Superposition Linearity Hypothesis. We provide evidence that superposition is an intrinsic property of the Transformer architecture rather than an emergent consequence of training; in fact, we observe
items.title_cn: 你的Transformer能同时持有两个想法：大模型线性叠加的证据
items.note: 提出叠加线性假设，证明不同文本流线性组合时输出为各自下一词分布的叠加。

items.title_en: WanPE: Towards Cinematic Prompt Enhancement for Modern Text-to-Video Generation
items.summary: Video generation begins in text space by authoring a cinematic screenplay, then materializes into pixels. As contemporary video generators scale to 30 seconds and faithfully follow complex conditions, the textual prompt largely directs the production, planning how actions, camera trajectories, lighting, and sound unfold across multi-shot sequences. In this paper, we present WanPE, a 397B-parameter prompt enhancement model trained on 1.05M real-world videos to master director-level cinematic plan
items.title_cn: WanPE：面向现代文生视频的电影级提示增强
items.note: 训练397B提示增强模型，把文本提示提升为导演级多镜头电影化规划以指导视频生成。

items.title_en: Agent-Editing World Model: Rethinking World Modeling for LLM Agents
items.summary: Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have enabled agents to tackle long-horizon tasks across diverse environments. To further improve agent performance, existing language world models typically predict environment observations, yet reconstructing high-entropy, execution-dependent tool responses offers limited value when real feedback is available. Meanwhile, agents suffer from task-state contamination, where unsupported assumptions and outdated plans persist in history and distort sub
items.title_cn: 智能体编辑世界模型：重思大模型智能体的世界建模
items.note: 主张世界模型不必重建工具响应，而应编辑任务状态，缓解历史假设污染问题。

items.title_en: Rufus-Air: An Open LLM Post-Training Recipe
items.summary: Rufus-Air is an open and reproducible post-training recipe on GLM-4.5-Air-Base (106B-A12B), organized as a serial pipeline of eight stages: SFT, Reasoning RL, Coding RL, Instruction-Following RL, General Agent, Coding Agent, Search Agent, and RLHF. We document the data, reward design, infrastructure, stage order, and stagewise results needed to reproduce the recipe. Stages progress from basic to advanced capabilities and from hard, verifiable rewards to softer judge-based signals. Training build
items.title_cn: Rufus-Air：一个开放的大模型后训练配方
items.note: 在GLM-4.5-Air上公开八阶段后训练流程，涵盖数据、奖励设计、基础设施与各阶段结果。

items.title_en: SpeakerMem-R1: Speaker-Centered Dual-Track Memory for Multi-Party Dialogue
items.summary: Long-term conversational memory in multi-party settings requires more than retrieving relevant content from long-term conversations: it must distinguish who said what, whom each statement concerns, how individuals perceive one another, what information is shared by the group, and how states change over time. Recent studies on multi-party dialogue benchmarks show that existing general-purpose LLM memory systems tend to lose person and group relations or struggle to integrate clues distributed acr
items.title_cn: SpeakerMem-R1：面向多方对话的以说话人为中心双轨记忆
items.note: 提出以说话人为中心的双轨记忆，区分谁说了什么、涉及谁及群体状态随时间的变化。

items.title_en: The Past Frames the Future: Memory for Autoregressive Video Generation
items.summary: Advances in generative models have improved video fidelity, enabling long-horizon generation, interactive world modeling, and evolving visual environments. Autoregressive (AR) video generation extends visual sequences through causal rollouts. However, a fundamental bottleneck emerges: as the generated sequence expands, practical models must operate under strictly bounded context windows, storage, and computational limits. Consequently, critical historical information, e.g., entity identities, dy
items.title_cn: 过去塑造未来：自回归视频生成的记忆机制
items.note: 针对自回归视频生成上下文受限导致历史信息丢失的问题，提出记忆机制保留实体与动态。

items.title_en: Spatial-Interactor: Learning Spatial Reasoning through Interaction with the Observable Physical World
items.summary: Spatial reasoning is essential for vision-language models (VLMs) to understand and act in the physical world. Reasoning in dynamic environments requires VLMs to perceive local state transitions caused by object motion and viewpoint changes and integrate them over long trajectories to maintain an updated spatial state, yet existing VLMs remain limited in both capabilities. Current spatial training primarily focuses on static questions about object attributes and spatial relations, providing limit
items.title_cn: Spatial-Interactor：通过与可观察物理世界交互学习空间推理
items.note: 让视觉语言模型通过交互感知物体运动与视角变化，并在长轨迹中维护更新空间状态。

items.title_en: HappyWorld-Bench
items.summary: Evaluating world models requires assessing both the quality of the worlds they generate and their consistency and responsiveness under exploration, interaction, and modification. We introduce HappyWorld-Bench, a comprehensive benchmark that evaluates whether generated worlds remain reliable as agents interact with them. Our design is built on a hierarchical capability framework of six world capabilities (W1-W6), from generative construction to unified world modeling, instantiated across three in
items.title_cn: HappyWorld-Bench：世界模型交互可靠性基准
items.note: 提出六项世界能力分层框架的基准，评估生成世界在智能体交互下是否仍可靠。

items.title_en: Just-in-Time Memory: Learning to Curate Task-Adaptive Memory for LLM Agents
items.summary: Agentic memory systems reuse past experience to improve future performance, yet most existing designs curate memory at write time: once a task is completed, its trajectory is distilled into a fixed artifact, such as a reflection, workflow, skill, or reasoning strategy, that is later retrieved by similarity. This forces the system to decide what is worth remembering before the future query is known, irreversibly discarding information and producing a query-independent summary that must serve many
items.title_cn: 即时记忆：为LLM智能体学习策展任务自适应记忆
items.note: 批评写入时固定记忆的做法，提出在查询时按任务即时策展自适应记忆。

items.title_en: The Tasteful Agent: Measuring and Improving Taste in Long-Horizon Tasks
items.summary: LLM agents increasingly work on long-horizon tasks, and the decisions they make along the way, such as which hypothesis to test or which implementation to build on, determine the outcome of the whole run. Making these decisions well is becoming a key capability for both engineering and research agents. We refer to the ability to make good long-horizon decisions as the taste of an agent. While existing benchmarks measure the end-to-end success of agents on long-horizon tasks, none of them measure
items.title_cn: 有品味的智能体：长时程任务中品味的测量与提升
items.note: 定义智能体长时程决策的“品味”能力，并提出测量与改进方法。

items.title_en: RULER: Instance-aware Rubric Rewards for SVG Generation
items.summary: Generating Scalable Vector Graphics (SVG) code from natural-language instructions is an open-ended task without absolute visual ground truth, leaving both evaluation and policy optimization without a faithful signal. Scalar metrics (CLIP, Aesthetic) calibrated on natural images transfer poorly to stylized vector content, and reusing them as RL rewards triggers reward hacking. We address both limitations with rubric-based scoring. We first establish empirically that prompting a vision-language ju
items.title_cn: RULER：面向SVG生成的实例感知评分标准奖励
items.note: 针对SVG无绝对视觉真值、标量指标易被奖励黑客的问题，提出基于评分标准的奖励。

items.title_en: Ovis-Embedding: Pushing the Frontiers of Universal Omni-Modal Embeddings
items.summary: In this report, we introduce Ovis-Embedding, a state-of-the-art omni-modal embedding family built on native integration of text, image, video, and audio. Instead of assembling separate modality towers, Ovis-Embedding uses a shared multimodal backbone to encode different modalities in a common representation space. Specifically, we make three key advances: (1) native omni-modal initialization: we adopt a pretrained Qwen-omni model as the embedding backbone and adapt it through contrastive trainin
items.title_cn: Ovis-Embedding：推进通用全模态嵌入前沿
items.note: 用共享多模态骨干原生编码文本、图像、视频与音频，实现统一表示空间的全模态嵌入。

items.title_en: GAE: Learning a Geometry-Native Latent Space for 3D-Consistent World Generation
items.summary: We present a compact geometry-native latent space as a shared foundation for perception and generation. Visual generators can produce photorealistic frames without preserving a consistent 3D scene. We argue that this is not only a modeling problem but also a representation problem: generators typically evolve appearance-centric latents, while perception models recover geometry in a semantically rich space that encodes cross-view structure. Rather than adding geometry as another output, we repara
items.title_cn: GAE：学习几何原生潜在空间以实现3D一致世界生成
items.note: 提出几何原生潜在空间作为感知与生成共享基础，使生成帧保持一致的3D场景。

items.title_en: StableVQ: Practical Guidelines for Stable Vector-Quantized Tokenizer Training
items.summary: Vector Quantization (VQ) is fundamental to discrete visual tokenizers that power modern autoregressive and masked image generation models. While recent shared-projection codebook methods have substantially advanced codebook utilization, training stability remains a critical and underexplored challenge. We argue that the root cause lies in the entanglement of the Encoder--Decoder and Codebook training: because neither module can reliably fulfill its own responsibility in isolation, the system can
items.title_cn: StableVQ：稳定向量量化分词器训练的实用指南
items.note: 指出编码解码器与码本训练纠缠是VQ不稳定根源，给出稳定训练的实用建议。

huggingface.models_summary: 这五个模型里，图像生成占了多数，说明文生图仍是开源社区最活跃的方向，且出现了无审查版、GGUF量化版、少步加速版等衍生玩法，反映社区在围绕大厂模型做二次改造。另外两个是文本分类和文本排序，属于偏基础的任务类型。对跟进AI圈和备考的人来说，值得注意：热门模型往往不是单一版本，而是官方版加各种社区变体，了解量化、加速、微调这些概念会更有帮助。
huggingface.papers_summary: 这批论文集中在几条主线：一是蒸馏与自进化，如在线蒸馏、多教师蒸馏、智能体自我改进与共同作弊问题；二是智能体与记忆，涉及长时程任务、工具自进化、即时记忆与品味评估；三是多模态与生成，包括全模态嵌入、文生视频提示增强、3D一致世界模型和音乐生成；四是效率与训练，如块稀疏注意力、分离式量化和VQ稳定性。新手可记住关键词：在线蒸馏、自进化智能体、记忆策展、世界模型、全模态嵌入、稀疏注意力。
